name: token_referent_ancestral_blade
note: Ancestral Blade: 'When this Equipment enters, create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token, then attach this Equipment to it.' The token is the object the create step acted on, so the Blade is attached to it and it is 2/2 ('Equipped creature gets +1/+1'). Red on main b02d7fc: the trigger did not parse, so no Soldier was made.
